title: Phase 3: retrieval options measured by a free proxy first (S2)
description:
## Purpose

Phase 3: measure retrieval options for the optional dynamic-retrieval feature cheaply, and spend live only on a clear winner.

## Scope

Free kNN proxy across lexical v1 / v2 (stop words) / v2+BM25, an opt-in cached embedding step, and at most one live D variant. Retrieval stays off by default; S3 Vectors and DynamoDB are design-only in core.

## Definition of done

S2 reached (at most one D variant chosen, or none), proxy results committed text-free, and the stop-word and embedding defaults confirmed or flipped per §5.4. Cost: ≈$0.01 embeddings + optional ≈$0.60 Jev.

## Design

[DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md](https://github.com/AnthusAI/Decision-Flywheel-Evaluations/blob/main/studies/DECISION_FLYWHEEL_DESIGN.md) §4, §5.2 (Retrieval comparison inside D), §6 step 6.
